effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Place 1 card with the [X Antibody] trait among them under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Trash the rest. If a card is placed by this effect, this Digimon can't have its DP reduced until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait from your hand under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card.
